observation_scope: global, 55 economies, not measured Malaysia-specific job demand
observation_unit: employer survey expectations about broad skill categories

mappings.wef_category: AI and big data / technological literacy
mappings.mapping_rationale: AI fluency overlaps broad technological literacy; not an exact WEF skill-code match.
Innovation-oriented thinking is an approximation of creative thinking; not an official mapping.
Critical thinking overlaps analytical thinking but is not identical.

model_policy.multiplier_interpretation: Illustrative +5% RELATIVE SCORING WEIGHT assigned by team to a mapped skill. NOT a WEF reported growth rate and NOT Malaysian labour-market growth.
model_policy.mechanism: For each source category with an expected-increase direction, apply the same conservative illustrative weight factor to exact mapped SkillShift skill IDs; no stacking or compounding between categories.
model_policy.refresh_trigger: new official edition or corrected source observations; do not change multiplier silently

limitations: WEF findings are global employer expectations, not Malaysian observed hiring or a time series of actual skill demand.
Semantic mappings to SkillShift skill IDs are interpretations, not source-defined skill identifiers.
1.05 is a team-chosen model sensitivity factor, not measured growth or a calibrated forecast.
Changes in readiness are weighted skill overlap, not job-employment probabilities.
Single-edition snapshot is refreshable but not an automatically updated or measured longitudinal trend.
